notes: Customer profile: national-level insurer with strict data residency for EU customers; POC is first step toward Private deployment.
POC scope: full Redwood Private control plane in customer VPC (dev), Terraform modules for infra, Helm for runtime, integration tests, security sign-off.
KMS: customer uses AWS KMS for secrets; they want an HSM-backed key for model encryption and logs to show key usage events.
Audit logging: must forward to Splunk HTTP Event Collector; retention controls enforced by customer (7 years for audit records on regulated datasets).
Model & runtime: prefer quantized open model (open-llama 13B or custom 30B quantized); fallback to smaller 7B for bursty low-latency traffic.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 inference <120ms for chat endpoints, sustained 800 qps for embedding batch jobs; cost sensitivity: medium-high.
Routing: want smart routing between Dedicated pool and Private VPC for DR; automatic fallback to lower-cost variant if capacity constrained.
Quote from CISO: 'We will only proceed if we get clear KMS integration docs and example audit events wired to our Splunk instance.'
AE note: 'Keep demo minimal — aim to prove KMS + audit + Terraform automation first; SE to prioritize network policy playbook.'
integration_details: Deliverables: Terraform modules (VPC, subnets, SGs, IAM roles), Helm charts for Redwood runtime, sample KMS policy snippets, Splunk HEC sample config, automated test plan + perf thresholds.

Performance: p95 inference latency <= 120ms after SE tuning
Ops: Runbook + rollback steps documented, runbook handed over to customer SRE
